name: Soul Surge
description:
About This Game

Soul Surge is a third-person action roguelite, with ARPG and bullet hell elements.

Fight your way through Ryn’s subconscious, defeat her inner demons, by unleashing powerful combination attacks fueled by Ryn’s core memories.

Wield the power of memories, equip your emotions and face the corruption.

7 UNIQUE UPGRADE CATEGORIES

Build towards your own unique playstyle with a variety of upgrade categories with unique effect, Combine them through augmentation, passives & actives. 

CHALLENGING BOSS FIGHTS

Experience highly choreographed intricate boss fights where learning their attack patterns while mastering your class is a must! Dodge, jump, dash & unleash powerful combo moves!

META PROGRESSION

Grow more powerful as you level up, gaining new unique skills, passives and additional augmentation sockets.

END-GAME

When you have conquered Soul Surge the end-game awaits you with infinitely scaling difficulty, new mechanics, additional challenges & recontextualization of what you have already conquered.
